name: Ribadesella (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ribadesella (the Victory Cross and a ship on blue and white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Ribadesella; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ribadesella arms — Victory Cross and ship above waves
